note.zh: 4201依次检查：本国创建的雇佣城邦→城邦已毁→曾攻击城邦→行虚者信任≥100→已突破虚境→普通主菜单。
note.en: Dispatcher 4201 checks in order: our own mercenary enclave → enclave destroyed → we attacked it → Shroudwalker trust ≥ 100 → we breached the Shroud → normal menu.

notes.zh: 此问候窗口沿用主菜单 shroud.4205 的全部选项（泽珞、袭击、后勤……以及赞助方提案 i），见主菜单分支。

notes.zh: 此窗口由被袭击的帝国看到，而不是出钱雇佣袭击的帝国。
notes.en: This window is shown to the raided empire, not to the empire that paid for the raid.

notes.zh: 被袭击的帝国此前未与灵督城邦建立通讯时显示此版本。

notes.zh: 后勤协议在3600天后到期时由城邦主动来信，可续约。
notes.en: Sent by the enclave when the 3600-day logistics contract expires; it can be renewed.

notes.zh: 仅当本国雇有灵督督管专员并首次与城邦交战时，五天后发生。
notes.en: Only if we employ a Mindwarden Commissioner; fires 5 days after our first battle against the enclave.
